scope: Five selected camera descriptor name fields only; no cross-cohort row changes and no whole callback-code equivalence claim.

sources.steam_code_policy: Only ordinary .shared instructions decoded; no .arch decoding or game execution.

ps2_descriptor_bank.reader: btlCameraSetState001bc660, source Battle/btlCamera.c:262-311, fallback entry=(u16)state*20 after btlEncounterGetRecord; actual forceReset/updateRange and init callback reads

golden_descriptor_bank.boundary: NSO70afd0 is the independently qualified next full768*52 camera preset bank, not another descriptor. Steam55 complete records match NSO ordered names, flag pairs and callback nullness; raw function addresses are platform-specific.

steam_setter.evidence: 7dbd7 encounter override call3fb80;7dbe8 LEAafa280;7dbef SHL5 then ADD;7dc09 forceReset+10;7dc36 publishes actualu16 state;7dc44 publishes action;7dc4b updateRange+14;7dca1 callback+0,7dcad indirect init(camera+30).

steam_frame.evidence: 7ed53 actual currentu16 state;7ed5d override3fb80;7ed6a LEAafa280;7ed71 SHL5;7ed78 callback+8;7ed8c indirect update(camera+30).

nso_setter.evidence: actualu16 state, override2560 else70a8f0+state*32, forceReset+16, updateRange+20, real camera global through880528, init+0(camera+30)

nso_frame.evidence: same live state+104, actual override2560 and32-byte fallback, per-frame callback+8, actual delay/enable state

negative_evidence.name: ESCAPE_MES
negative_evidence.requirement: Same literal also occurs in action-state descriptors: Steam a24f20 and NSO709d50. These are not the camera descriptor label fields afa3b8/70aa28; name uniqueness alone would choose the wrong enclosing object.

All51 old records are not index-equivalent: full-table comparison positively found the inserted bike message at49 and shifted down/defense states. No blanket pointer-width or numeric-address match is used.

required_seams.requirement: Golden-only resolve each selected label through its actual native camera descriptor identity: IDs5 REINFORCE,9 ESCAPE_MES,32 OVERLIMIT,39 CONDITION,43 NYX FEATHER. Author qualified Steam NUL-terminated values, never PS2 literal values or arbitrary numeric xrefs. Retain only explicitly recorded PS2 alignment tails. Cover every direct/translated/inlined/native reference. This qualifies label fields, not the entire camera callback implementation.

required_seams.owner: actual camera state producers and descriptor role
required_seams.requirement: Actual state setter accepts u16 requested state, actual action reference and clear-unit-flags argument. Preserve actual encounter-specific descriptor override (Steam3fb80/NSO2560) before fallback32-byte table indexing, same-state forceReset, state history/repeat count, frame/delay reset, action publication, updateRange flag and optional initialization. Per-frame reader consumes the current real camera state and its actual override, delay/enable flags and +8 callback. Runtime label identity must follow the selected descriptor, not a fake isolated state or cosmetic unused table; no PS2/host pointer reinterpretation.

Do not treat a widened51-record PS2 copy as the Golden55-record table. IDs0..48 keep their observed names/flags/callback-nullness; Golden inserts BIKE_PURSUIT_MES49, moves DOWN_REC49->50 and DEFENSE50->51, and adds UNION_A52,UNION_B53,ALL_SP54. Selected five IDs are unchanged. Qualify mode isolation, all five label references and retained boundaries, same-state reset and encounter override, including an override-name path. Source proof alone is not a runtime consumer witness; callback code behavior is not admitted by matching names.
